description: Reproduction of signed illustration. The head of a woman appears against a white background. The woman has long black hair that hangs down in elegant curls, forming an Art Noveau design. Small white circles decorate the woman's hair and ears like a matching set of earrings and a hairclip.
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
